summary: All 11 target episodes (14-24) promoted to full anchors with own starts; nothing left zone-level. S2's shape: ep14 compresses the vol-6 Otohiko-test arc to chs 31-34 (the Kayako rival is cut entirely - MAL thread confirms - and chs 35-36's egg-contest resolution is dropped, replaced by an anime Mamoru-library purification built from ch 33-34 beats); eps 15-23 then run nearly linear (39-40, 41-42, 43-45, 46-48, 49+51, 52-53, 54-55, 56-58, 58-60), skipping ch 37-38 (grafted into S1 ep11) and ch 50 (whose group date - including Kohiruimaki, whom batch 15 wrongly called anime-only - was pulled forward into S1 ep10's Christmas goukon); ep24 is the season's one hard reorder, opening with ch 64's Kirihito stone-mirror Yomi expedition grafted ahead of ch 61's New Year gate/child transformation. Ep25 (finale, existing envelope anchor) actually adapts only 62-63 - repairs filed (END 64->63, start 31->62). Chs 35-36 and 65-66 (New Year demon market) are adapted nowhere. Key per-chapter sources: completed-manga-review.blog parts 3-5 (chapter-by-chapter summaries 20-66), the Ukrainian sister wiki's per-chapter character lists (chs 31-51), and EN fandom first-appearance infobox pairs (Mamoru ch32/ep14, Izanami ch43/ep17, Botanmaru+Yatori ch51/ep19, Suirou anime ep20, Soujoubou ch59, Toshigami ch63); EN fandom chapter pages are stubs in this zone and episode infoboxes are all TBA, so the batch-15 chapter-page reverse-map method was replaced by these.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 31-34 (compressed; Kayako-rival thread cut, chs 35-36's egg-contest resolution dropped and replaced by an anime library-purification finish built from ch 33-34 beats)
anchors.note: Otohiko's Izumo invitation (31), shikigami-egg test + monkey hatch + school tsuchigumo (32), miasma/library attack + talisman overuse (33), Otohiko's stop-writing-talismans advice + naming Mamoru + purification (34). Two MAL posters confirm the Kayako cut; the test's manga resolution (35-36) never airs.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 39-40 (chs 37-38 skipped here - already grafted into S1 ep11)
anchors.note: Shogi for the Izumo seat + ticket errand + fallen-gods street attack on Kirihito + kiss attempt + Mizuki chosen (39; UA char list has the fallen gods, Akura-O, Kikuichi, Monjiro); Himemiko send-off, arrival, separation, gods' disdain, Mikage's guiding light, entering the hall (40 - fandom ch-40 summary matches the episode ending exactly).

anchors.chapters_adapted: 41-42, 43 (opening only: Yomi food-temptation/caveman mob + Izanami's summons)
anchors.note: Ookuninushi's gate-guarding request + Tekkimaru smashing the gate with Kirihito's weapon + Nanami's plunge after rotting Kirihito (41; UA list: Okuninushi, Takehaya, Tetsukimaru, guard bull); Tomoe's red-light-district drinking + tanuki geishas' Akura-ou tale (42; UA list has Mizutama, whose anime debut is this episode). Manga's apologize-to-Kayako exchange restaged as search-for-Mikage. END=42; the ch-43 fragment is the cliffhanger.

Izanami feast/imprisonment advice (43 - Izanami's paired debut: manga ch43, anime this episode), talisman search + Kirihito Mori avalanche/possession flashback with mother Ako Mori + Hio debut (44), hair-lock survival reveal + escape + Hio chase + Takehaya's sealed exit broken by yokai-form Tomoe (45; anime credits Kotetsu, manga the lucky mallet).

Back at Izumo, Tomoe imprisoned as a wild yokai + Ookuninushi (46), re-contract kiss + sleeping-kiss feelings test + helping the gods + human-world outing (47), Tomoe's tactless festival antics (camisole beat) + Mikage found and his reasons explained (48; UA ch-48 list includes Mikage and the Yukiji flashback). Clean vol-8 close.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 49, 51 (49 altered: the Kayako farewell chat is restaged as the Himemiko town outing and Ookuninushi's love-isn't-taboo stance is inverted; ch 50's group date skipped - its beats were pulled into S1 ep10)
anchors.note: Summit farewell + relationship talk (49), Yatori offers Kirihito the Kurama-mountain plot + Botanmaru met + Shinjirou = Kurama reveal + concert (51 - Botanmaru's and Yatori's paired manga debuts are both ch 51, anime this episode).

Kurama's childhood flashback + enchanted fog + scythe-Suirou illusion broken by the flute (52), Suirou's house + no-women rules + withering thousand-year tree restored + Jiro's transfixed stare (53). Ep 21 opens with ch 54's first beat (wrist grab / Mamoru bite) - clean seam. Suirou's anime debut is this episode (manga ch 51, in Botanmaru's tale).

anchors.chapters_adapted: 54-55, 56 (opening only: the grand entrance past the front gate)
anchors.note: Jiro's wrist-grab + Mamoru's rescue + elders push Kurama for chief + Suirou's leave-the-mountain advice rejected (54), temple ejections + Yatori taunting Jiro's wavering wards + shared room/divider (anime: sleepwalking into Tomoe's bed) + infiltration plan assigning Nanami-Botanmaru vs Kurama-Tomoe (55).

anchors.chapters_adapted: 56-58 (58 only through the ward-break/compound purification; its cavern tail opens ep 23)
anchors.note: Failed drinking ploy + Tomoe-as-Nanami seduction + Yatori's tip-off (56), imprisonment + frozen Soujoubou found + Yatori's soul-theft-by-fake-letter reveal + Mamoru binds Yatori + Jiro and the frightened tengu children (57), ward-break and purification that frees the cage (58). Episode ends mid-ch-58; continue point is 58 itself.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 58 (tail: soul hunt, Raijiuyuu cavern, Jiro shields Nanami), 59-60
anchors.note: Raijiuyuu destroys Jiro's wings + Tomoe defeats it + it disgorges Soujoubou's soul + elixir/peach-pill recovery (59 - EN ch-59 stub has the Tomoe/Kurama talisman search; Soujoubou's manga debut is ch 59), wings regrow + eternal-cherry-blossom viewing + Jiro's stay-with-me tree talk + the pills-were-for-Tomoe reveal + drunk confession (60). Finale of the mountain arc; vol 10 closes.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 64 (Kirihito's stone-mirror Yomi expedition with Yatori - body on the flame mountain, forced retreat, mirror smashed - pulled forward from the vol-11 side story), 61
anchors.note: Episode opens with ch 64's graft (manga motive: his mother's knock; anime: leaking fumes), then ch 61: Himemiko wedding hopes + New Year zodiac-greeting trip + gate limbo + Nanami emerging as her 12-years-ago self + first childhood flashback (father's debts, mother heckled). Non-monotonic by design; Yatori's Akura-ou-and-Tomoe reminiscence draws on his ch-51/past-arc backstory.

continue_points.note: ends mid-ch 58 (after the compound purification); the chapter's cavern tail is adapted by ep 23, so the honest resume is ch 58 itself

annotation_updates.note: corrected zone facts: the Christmas goukon half of S1 ep10 adapts ch 50 (vol 9) pulled forward - Kohiruimaki and the date boys (Tanaka/Sato/Yamada) are ch 50 characters and Tomoe's jealous intervention + snake-Mizuki scare are ch 50 beats - merged with ch 25's beats; batch 15's 'Kohirui Maki exists nowhere in the manga' was wrong. The flashback half still grafts ~96-101 past-arc material.

S2 zone statement superseding the ep25 season envelope: near-linear run 31-63 with chs 37-38 and 50 pre-consumed by S1 (eps 11 and 10), chs 35-36 dropped entirely (Kayako resolution), and ch 64 grafted forward into ep 24 ahead of 61-63; chs 65-66 (New Year demon market) adapted nowhere.

repairs.why: Finale anchors to what it adapts: ep 25 adapts chs 62-63 (mother's independence lessons, Tomoe's play-through of the memory + promise, Toshigami's seal + mother's photo, exit and 'it was Tomoe' realization); ch 64 is the Kirihito mirror side story, consumed by ep 24's opening graft. Anime swapped ch 63's zodiac dragon for a sheep (2015).
Stored start 31 was the season envelope; with eps 14-24 promoted per-episode, ep 25's own start is ch 62 (ep 24 ends at ch 61's flashback; ep 25 opens with the mother's lessons).

repairs.new: 62-63 (memory dive resolution + Toshigami; zodiac dragon changed to a sheep for 2015)
repairs.why: Envelope replaced by the per-episode record; the envelope's factual content now lives in the S2 zone annotation.

repairs.old: 25 (beats reworked: goukon replaces the summer-festival setting; flashback half grafts past-arc material later depicted ~chs 96-101, cf. OADs)
repairs.new: 25, 50 (goukon merges ch 50's group date - Kohiruimaki, Tanaka, Sato, Yamada, Tomoe's jealous kick, snake-Mizuki scare - with ch 25's beats, restaged at Christmas; flashback half grafts ~chs 96-101 past-arc material)
repairs.why: Batch 15 called mixer boy Kohirui Maki anime-only; he is Kohiruimaki, a named ch-50 character, and the goukon's structure and gags are ch 50's, pulled forward from vol 9. Two independent sources list him in ch 50.

flags_for_sean: ep10 END/volume follow-up: with the goukon identified as ch 50, ep10's running-order END is arguably 50 (v9) rather than 25 (v5) if the mixer segment closes the episode (ja-wiki lists 'Tomoe Becomes a Familiar' before 'The God Goes to a Mixer', suggesting it does); repair filed only for chapters_adapted - END/volume left for a ruling since the in-episode segment order wasn't re-verified frame-level. Ep10's 'mixed' type ruling still holds via the ~96-101 flashback graft.

Never-adapted gaps inside the S2 window: chs 35-36 (Kayako egg-contest resolution) and chs 65-66 (New Year demon-market chapters) appear in no episode; ch 49's Kayako farewell survives only as the restaged Himemiko outing. Kayako Hiiragi (manga debut ch 31) is cut from the entire anime.
ep22/ep23 boundary lands mid-ch 58 (purification vs cavern tail); no page-level source exists - continue point after ep22 recorded as 58 itself. A Viz page-split source would settle it if one exists.

Post-S2 continue: internet advice ('continue at ch 64') is imprecise - ch 64 is consumed by ep 24's graft; the pure-manga honest resume after ep 25 is ch 65 (or 67 to skip straight to the next arc/vol 12). Stored ep25 continue->80 is the watch-order ruling (OADs next) and was left untouched.

Source-landscape note for future batches: EN fandom chapter pages are stubs beyond ch 42 and all S2 episode infoboxes say 'Manga Chapter(s) = TBA'; the working method here was completed-manga-review.blog's chapter-by-chapter posts (parts 3-5 cover chs 20-109, verified against the vol-12 boundary at ch 67), the Ukrainian sister wiki's per-chapter character lists (chs 31-51; its ch-51 page is a corrupted copy of ch 50 - do not trust), and EN fandom first-appearance infobox pairs.
